pages.text: [#](53341a)You found them, then — five of the old village tales, copied out in trembling hands and left to yellow in chest and cellar. I felt you reading.[#]()
pages.title: The Gathered Lives

pages.text: [#](53341a)A tale is a kind of taglock, pupil: a knot tied around a life, holding it fast against forgetting.[#]()
[#](53341a)Most witches work a coven of the living. Three sisters at a circle, five, seven — voices stacked until the working is loud enough to be heard.[#]()
[#](53341a)But a witch alone, far from any sister, learns a quieter trick. She does not gather the living. She gathers the remembered.[#]()
[#](53341a)I learned it the winter I was the last witch in three valleys.[#]()
pages.title: The Telling

pages.text: [#](53341a)The others were under the rowans by then — Mistress Vale, who taught bells to listen; Selene of the cracked mirror; old Mother Hem, who tied malice[#]()
[#](53341a)backward; the broom-witch Nettie; and the midwife Annis, whose shard grew warm before a child ever turned.[#]()
[#](53341a)I had no coven. I had their stories.[#]()
[#](53341a)So I read them aloud over the circle, one after another, until the air went the second kind of silent — not empty, but listening. And then they came.[#]()
[#](53341a)Not the women. The shape the women left in the world. Pale, footless, drifting a hand's breadth above the chalk.[#]()
[#](53341a)Do not mistake them for the dead returned. The dead have better things to do than stand in your draughty barn.[#]()
pages.title: What They Are

pages.text: [#](53341a)What rises is the coven-shape itself — the weight of five lives well-remembered, lent to your working as if the sisters stood beside you again.[#]()
[#](53341a)They do not speak. They do not walk. They turn slowly to face the altar and wait, and while they wait, the circle counts them as kin.[#]()
[#](53341a)That is the whole of the gift: a witch alone may now cast what only a coven could.[#]()
[#](53341a)Call a familiar's beast, summon what needs more than one voice — the spectral sisters make up the number. They fade by themselves before long.[#]()
[#](53341a)Tales tire of being told, and so do the told.[#]()
[#](53341a)**9x9** ring - **Otherwhere** chalk - **2000** altar power[#]()
[#](53341a)Draw a **medium Otherwhere circle** and lay an altar near with **2000 power** to spend.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Offer a **Mellifluous Hunger** — the token that calls them — together with a **Mandrake Root** and a sprig of **Wormwood**.[#]()
[#](53341a)The hunger draws the shapes; the root and the wormwood give them somewhere to stand.[#]()
[#](53341a)Five spectral witches rise and drift about the circle. They count toward any coven a later rite demands, so cast your coven-working while they linger.[#]()
[#](53341a)They keep no altar long — when they fade, simply gather the lives again.[#]()
